'''Limmie''', also called '''bolo-ball''' depending on the location, was a sport. The [[Galactic Cup of Limmie]] was composed of many teams throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Though a popular sport on many planets, it was almost ignored on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Even Galactic Cup matches held on Coruscant were poorly attended, and [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] sportswriters did not seem to fully understand the rules. By contrast, the people of the planet [[Fwillsving]] were highly enthusiastic limmie fans. After Fwillsving's team defeated [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]] in a [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] Galactic Cup match, the ensuing celebrations left the city of [[Svitalos]] in ruins. Limmie was the favorite sport of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]]. In [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']], the game was called ''mesh'geroya''&mdash;the beautiful game.<ref name="Imperial Commando:501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] the Galactic Cup was put on hiatus after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]], and [[Team Alderaan]] was dissolved.<ref name="Cael">[[Takeover at Whisper Base (adventure)|''Takeover at Whisper Base'']] Cael Soldier Character Folio</ref>

==Rules of the game==
Two teams play against each other, trying to score a goal. Single points are awarded for each goal. Actions like kicks, headers and physical contact in the form of tackles are allowed. An off-side rule also exists, and penalties are levied for infringements. The game is refereed by an on-field referee and two linesmen over two timed halves.<ref name="Imperial Commando:501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2008]], introduced an inconsistency in the naming of the sport. While an article on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]] in [[2002]] specified that the game was called limmie in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and bolo-ball outside of the Core, ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' stated the opposite. The discrepancy was never resolved.

Limmie strongly resembles the real-world sport of [[Wikipedia:Association football|football]] (known in the United States as soccer): they have almost identical rules, and both are nicknamed "the beautiful game." The unpopularity of limmie on Coruscant may be a reference to soccer's low popularity in the United States in contrast to the rest of the world.
